_comment: Rediscovery ground truth, kept in a separate file so it can never leak into the evidence ledger the engine reasons over. Each entry is a real, published discovery of a target-disease link that did not exist in the literature before `discovered_year`. The `abc` test asks: restricted to knowledge before that year, does the engine's open-discovery pass surface this pair, and how highly does it rank it?

rediscovery_cases.what_happened: Robin, a multi-agent system from FutureHouse, autonomously generated the hypothesis that enhancing retinal pigment epithelium phagocytosis could treat dry age-related macular degeneration, selected ROCK inhibitors as the intervention class, and nominated ripasudil -- an approved glaucoma drug. Human experimenters ran the assays; ripasudil increased RPE phagocytosis. Concept to paper took about two and a half months.
rediscovery_cases.citation: FutureHouse, 'Demonstrating end-to-end scientific discovery with Robin, a multi-agent system', 2025
rediscovery_cases.why_it_is_a_fair_test: Every edge the engine needs was public well before 2025: ROCK sits in Rho/ROCK actin regulation (1996), actin remodelling gates phagocytic engulfment (2000s), RPE phagocytosis of shed outer segments fails in dry AMD (2008), and ripasudil was an approved ROCK inhibitor (2014). The A-C edge -- ROCK to dry AMD -- was the thing nobody had written down.

rediscovery_cases.what_happened: BenevolentAI queried a machine-read knowledge graph and identified clathrin-mediated endocytosis as the likely route of SARS-CoV-2 entry, and baricitinib -- a rheumatoid arthritis JAK inhibitor that also inhibits the numb-associated kinases AAK1 and GAK -- as an agent that would block it while also damping the cytokine response. Baricitinib went on to reduce mortality in ACTT-2 and COV-BARRIER and received emergency authorisation.
rediscovery_cases.citation: Richardson et al., Lancet 2020; Stebbing et al., Front Pharmacol 2021 (expert-augmented computational drug repurposing)
rediscovery_cases.why_it_is_a_fair_test: AAK1's role in clathrin-mediated endocytosis was published in 2002 and endocytosis as a viral entry route long before 2020. With the COVID19 disease node present but no AAK1-COVID19 evidence atom, the engine has exactly the information BenevolentAI's graph had.
rediscovery_cases.caveat: The COVID19 disease node and its process edges are dated 2020 in the entity graph, so this case tests bridge-finding given a new disease node, not prediction of the pandemic itself. Run it with --allow-new-disease-node.
